SELECT date, zip_code
FROM weather
WHERE min_dew_point_f < (SELECT MIN(min_dew_point_f) FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94107)

FROM weather
WHERE min_dew_point_f < (SELECT MIN(min_dew_point_f) FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94107)

FROM trip
JOIN station
ON trip.end_station_id = station.id;
